findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is an endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies or affinity-head derivatives.

The observed support is the learning window [0.0,0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no absolute affinity label is available in the observed window.

Curve support is restricted: only 24 of 200 continuous features pass the selection rule (absolute integrated z >= 0.1, batch direction fraction >= 0.857, q < 0.05, scale floor excluded), and the fidelity rule requires relative RMSE <= 0.35, zero strong sign-conflict nodes and quiet-node large-fit fraction <= 0.1.

The information audit reports 14 independent batches and a compressed-choice excess fixed-frame RMS of about 0.081 A (CI95 ~0.070-0.092), with top4 teacher overlap ~0.47 and chosen teacher score correlation ~0.10; the audit explicitly states these are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and that nonnegative excess distance is by construction, not a causal affinity effect.

Lineage support covers 14 complete survival batches over 700 batch nodes, but 349 nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 have fewer than 6; terminal metadata shows a single future-resampling node per batch at terminal score time 0.99, outside the observed window, so last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

hypotheses.direction: Favor features whose signed contrast is stable in sign across the observed window and consistent across independent batches.
hypotheses.falsifier: Sign reversal of the contrast within the observed window, or batch direction fraction below the registered 0.857 threshold, would falsify the directional claim.
hypotheses.observable: Signed contrast of the selected fidelity-passing coordinate features at observed score nodes over [0.0,0.5].
hypotheses.scope: Observed window only; no extrapolation beyond 0.5 and no terminal-label claim.
hypotheses.statement: Signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes, restricted to the 24 fidelity-passing features, may carry more usable directional signal than isolated marginal descriptors, but this remains a selection-enrichment statement rather than an absolute geometric or affinity descriptor.

hypotheses.direction: Prefer time-conditioning only for features with validated sign or rate changes; keep constant otherwise.
hypotheses.falsifier: Absence of validated sign changes or rate changes in the selected features would remove support for a time-conditioned rule.
hypotheses.observable: Sign changes and first/last rate behavior of the selected continuous contrast functions across their complete observed support.
hypotheses.scope: Observed support [0.0,0.5]; no arbitrary time bins.
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned contrast rule may be distinguishable from a constant rule only where validated fits or observed-node interpolation show sign changes or rate changes; otherwise the constant rule is preferred.

hypotheses.direction: Downweight directions whose selection evidence conflicts with survival credit.
hypotheses.falsifier: If survival credit is fully explained by ancestral coverage and survivor bias, the disagreement signal is not usable for direction priorities.
hypotheses.observable: Comparison of selection-node contrasts with descendant survival or quality credit under the parent-debiased strata.
hypotheses.scope: 14 complete survival batches; ancestral coverage is sparse (349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors).
hypotheses.statement: Disagreement between immediate selection evidence and available descendant survival credit, if present, should reorder direction priorities, but without decoded terminal labels the last-record credit must not be reported as final affinity benefit.

limitations: No current study outcome data are supplied to the design roles; final affinity benefit cannot be evaluated here.
Recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no absolute affinity label exists in the observed window.
Terminal labels are not decoded; last-record joint-head credit is not final affinity benefit and the unavailable comparison is reported as such.
Coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies and do not establish neural-module causation.
Only 24 of 200 continuous features pass the registered selection and fidelity rules; the remaining features are unsupported for directional claims.
Ancestral coverage is sparse (349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors, 531 with fewer than 6), limiting lineage-based inference.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and were not proposed for edit.
